final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS a FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation HAVING COUNT(bandusagepct) > 0), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS b FROM s1 WHERE a IS NOT NULL), s3 AS (SELECT s1.a AS a, s1.a - s2.b AS d FROM s1 CROSS JOIN s2 WHERE s2.b IS NOT NULL AND s1.a > s2.b) SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_step1_average, AVG(d) AS avg_a_minus_b FROM s3
